```{r helpers}
no_leading_zero = function(x) {
  out = scales::number(x, accuracy = 0.01, trim = TRUE)
  out = sub("^0\\.", ".", out)
  out = ifelse(x %% 1 == 0, as.character(as.integer(x)), out)
  out
}

bf_one_sample = function(x, mu = 0.5, bf = "01") {
  if (length(na.omit(x)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  bf10 = BayesFactor::extractBF(BayesFactor::ttestBF(x = x, mu = mu), onlybf = TRUE)
  if (bf == "01") 1 / bf10 else bf10
}

safe_t = function(x, mu = 0.5, what = c("t", "p")) {
  what = match.arg(what)
  if (length(na.omit(x)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  res = t.test(x, mu = mu)
  if (what == "t") round(unname(res$statistic), 3) else round(res$p.value, 3)
}

safe_d = function(x, mu = 0.5) {
  if (length(na.omit(x)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  round(effectsize::cohens_d(x, mu = mu)$Cohens_d, 3)
}

calc_caf = function(df, binwidth = my_caf_binwidth, min_n = 20) {
  upper = ceiling(max(df$rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE) / binwidth) * binwidth
  breaks = seq(0, upper, by = binwidth)
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(rt_bin = cut(rt_ms, breaks = breaks)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(study_label, procedural_cutoff_ms, condition, rt_bin) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      mean_rt = mean(rt_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_correct = sum(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = dplyr::n(),
      acc = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n >= min_n) %>%
    dplyr::rowwise() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ci_low = binom.test(n_correct, n)$conf.int[1],
      ci_high = binom.test(n_correct, n)$conf.int[2],
      above_chance = ci_low > 0.5
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

calc_caf_threshold = function(caf_df) {
  caf_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(study_label, condition) %>%
    dplyr::filter(above_chance) %>%
    dplyr::slice_min(mean_rt, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(study_label, condition, mean_rt, n, acc, ci_low, ci_high)
}
```

# Load and check data

```{r load_data}
raw_root_path = paste0(root_path, "/2_simulators/mvct/behav_demo_data/raw/")
study_specs_raw = tidyr::tribble(
  ~study, ~study_label, ~file, ~procedural_cutoff_ms,
  1, "Study 1", "mvct_raw_data_study1.xlsx", 520,
  2, "Study 2", "mvct_raw_data_study2.xlsx", 510
  )

read_study_raw_data = function(root_path, file, study, study_label, procedural_cutoff_ms, sheet = 1) {
  data_path = file.path(root_path, file)
  readxl::read_excel(data_path, sheet = sheet) %>%
    dplyr::filter(trial_type == "test") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      study = study,
      study_label = study_label,
      procedural_cutoff_ms = procedural_cutoff_ms,
      participant = as.integer(pp),
      condition = group,
      symbol = mean,
      RT = rt,
      rt_ms = rt * 1000,
      correct = as.integer(correct)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(study, study_label, procedural_cutoff_ms,
           participant, condition, symbol,
           RT, rt_ms, correct)
}

df_all_studies = pmap_dfr(
  study_specs_raw,
  ~ read_study_raw_data(
    root_path = raw_root_path,
    study = ..1,
    study_label = ..2,
    file = ..3,
    procedural_cutoff_ms = ..4
  )
)

df_study1 = df_all_studies %>% filter(study == 1)
df_study2 = df_all_studies %>% filter(study == 2)
```

```{r sanity_check}
calc_sanity = function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(study_label, condition) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_subj = n_distinct(participant),
      n_trials = n(),
      mean_acc = mean(correct),
      median_rt = median(rt_ms),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

sanity_results = calc_sanity(df_all_studies)
sanity_results %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(mean_acc = round(mean_acc, 2), median_rt = round(median_rt, 0))
```

# RT distributions

```{r distributions}
plot_distributions = function(df, plot_title, xlim_up = 5000, binwidth = 200) {
  cutoff = unique(df$procedural_cutoff_ms)
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("guess", "control"), ordered = T)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(resp = ifelse(correct == 1, "correct", "incorrect")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = rt_ms, color = condition, linetype = resp, group = interaction(condition, resp))) +
    geom_freqpoly(binwidth = binwidth, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xlim_up)) +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Group", values = c("guess" = col_g, "control" = col_c),
                       labels = c("guess" = "Guessing", "control" = "Control")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(name = "Response", values = c("correct" = "solid", "incorrect" = "dashed"),
                          labels = c("correct" = "Correct", "incorrect" = "Incorrect")) +
    guides(linetype = guide_legend(order = 1, 
                                   title.position = "top",
                                   title.hjust = 0.5,
                                   nrow = 1, override.aes = list(color = "black")),
           color = guide_legend(order = 2,
                                title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
                                nrow = 1, override.aes = list(linetype = "solid"))) +
    labs(title = plot_title, x = "Response Time (ms)", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.line = element_line(color = "black"))
}

p_dist_1 = plot_distributions(df_study1, plot_title = "Study 1")
p_dist_2 = plot_distributions(df_study2, plot_title = "Study 2")

guide_area() / (p_dist_1 + p_dist_2) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.11, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        legend.justification = "center",
        legend.box = "horizontal",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "lightgrey", linewidth = 0.4),
        legend.box.background = element_blank(),
        legend.margin = margin(2, 8, 2, 8),
        legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 6, 0))
```

# Conditional accuracy functions

```{r caf_compute}
caf_results = calc_caf(df_all_studies, binwidth = my_caf_binwidth, min_n = 20)
```

```{r caf_plot}
plot_caf = function(caf_df,
                    condition_levels = c("guess", "control"),
                    condition_labels = c("Guessing", "Control"),
                    condition_cols   = c(col_g, col_c),
                    my_linewidth = 0.6,
                    xlim_up = 1150,
                    base_font_size = 9,
                    title_font_size = 11) {

  cutoff_df = caf_df %>%
    dplyr::distinct(procedural_cutoff_ms)

  caf_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      condition = factor(condition, 
                         levels = condition_levels, 
                         labels = condition_labels, 
                         ordered = TRUE)) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(
      ggplot2::aes(x = mean_rt, y = acc, 
                   color = condition, fill = condition,
                   linetype = condition, shape = condition)) +
    ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = my_linewidth, alpha = 1) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "longdash", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(data = cutoff_df, 
                        ggplot2::aes(xintercept = procedural_cutoff_ms), 
                        inherit.aes = FALSE, linetype = "dotted", color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xlim_up), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = no_leading_zero) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = stats::setNames(condition_cols, condition_labels),
                                breaks = condition_labels) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = stats::setNames(condition_cols, condition_labels),
      breaks = condition_labels
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_linetype_manual(
      values = stats::setNames(rep("solid", length(condition_labels)), condition_labels),
      breaks = condition_labels
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(
      values = stats::setNames(rep(16, length(condition_labels)), condition_labels),
      breaks = condition_labels
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = unique(caf_df$study_label),
      x = "Response Time Bin (ms)", y = "Proportion Correct",
      color = "Group", fill = "Group", linetype = "Group", shape = "Group") +
    ggplot2::guides(color = ggplot2::guide_legend(
      title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(alpha = 1, linewidth = my_linewidth, size = 1.5)),
      fill = "none", linetype = "none", shape = "none") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_family = my_fig_font, base_size = base_font_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      text = ggplot2::element_text(family = my_fig_font, size = base_font_size),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(family = my_fig_font, hjust = 0.5, size = title_font_size),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(family = my_fig_font, size = base_font_size),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(family = my_fig_font, size = base_font_size, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4)
    )
}

p_caf_1 = caf_results %>%
```

# Descriptive empirical boundary 

The earliest bin whose exact binomial 95% CI lies entirely above .50, per study and group. The boundary is the mean RT of that bin.

```{r caf_threshold}
calc_caf_threshold(caf_results) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_rt = round(mean_rt, 0),
    acc = round(acc, 2),
    ci_low  = round(ci_low, 2),
    ci_high = round(ci_high, 2)
  )

empirical_thresholds = calc_caf_threshold(caf_results) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(study_label, condition, empirical_threshold_ms = mean_rt)
```

# Fast-response prevalence

```{r prevalence}
prevalence = df_all_studies %>%
  dplyr::left_join(empirical_thresholds, by = c("study_label", "condition")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study_label, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = dplyr::n(),
    n_below_procedural = sum(rt_ms < unique(procedural_cutoff_ms)),
    pct_below_procedural = round(mean(rt_ms < unique(procedural_cutoff_ms)) * 100, 2),
    acc_below_procedural = round(mean(correct[rt_ms < unique(procedural_cutoff_ms)], na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    n_below_empirical = sum(rt_ms < unique(empirical_threshold_ms)),
    pct_below_empirical = round(mean(rt_ms < unique(empirical_threshold_ms)) * 100, 2),
    acc_below_empirical = round(mean(correct[rt_ms < unique(empirical_threshold_ms)], na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(prevalence, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

# Accuracy below the empirical boundary

```{r}
df_all_studies %>%
  dplyr::left_join(empirical_thresholds, by = c("study_label", "condition")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rt_ms < empirical_threshold_ms) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study_label, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_below = dplyr::n(), n_correct = sum(correct), acc_below = mean(correct), .groups   = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ci_low = binom.test(n_correct, n_below)$conf.int[1], ci_high = binom.test(n_correct, n_below)$conf.int[2]) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(c(acc_below, ci_low, ci_high), ~ round(.x, 3)))

df_all_studies %>%
  dplyr::left_join(empirical_thresholds, by = c("study_label", "condition")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rt_ms < empirical_threshold_ms) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study_label, participant, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(acc = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE), n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n >= 10) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study_label, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_subj = dplyr::n(),
    mean_acc = round(mean(acc), 3),
    ci_low = round(mean(acc) - 1.96 * sd(acc) / sqrt(dplyr::n()), 3),
    ci_high = round(mean(acc) + 1.96 * sd(acc) / sqrt(dplyr::n()), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Participant spread in the fast chance-level region

```{r participant_spread}
group_totals = df_all_studies %>%
  dplyr::distinct(study_label, condition, participant) %>%
  dplyr::count(study_label, condition, name = "n_participants_total")

spread = df_all_studies %>%
  dplyr::left_join(empirical_thresholds, by = c("study_label", "condition")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rt_ms < empirical_threshold_ms) %>%
  dplyr::count(study_label, condition, participant, name = "n_fast") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study_label, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_with_fast = dplyr::n(), # participants with >= 1 fast trial
    n_with_10plus = sum(n_fast >= 10), # participants with >= 10 fast trials
    median_per_pp = median(n_fast),
    q25_per_pp = quantile(n_fast, 0.25),
    q75_per_pp = quantile(n_fast, 0.75),
    max_per_pp = max(n_fast),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(group_totals, by = c("study_label", "condition")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct_with_fast = round(100 * n_with_fast / n_participants_total, 1)) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(n_participants_total, .after = n_with_fast)

print(spread, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r fixed_cutoff}
df_all_studies %>%
  dplyr::filter(rt_ms < procedural_cutoff_ms) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study_label, participant, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(acc = mean(correct, na.rm = TRUE),

  dplyr::group_by(study_label, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(

    t = safe_t(acc, mu = 0.5, what = "t"),
    p = safe_t(acc, mu = 0.5, what = "p"),
    cohens_d = safe_d(acc, mu = 0.5),
    BF01 = round(bf_one_sample(acc, mu = 0.5, bf = "01"), 3),
    BF10 = round(bf_one_sample(acc, mu = 0.5, bf = "10"), 3),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )
```

# Bimodality: Hartigan's dip test

```{r dip_test}
calc_dip_results = function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(correct == 1) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(study_label, participant, condition) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(dip_p = dip.test(rt_ms)$p.value, n_trials = n(), .groups = "drop")
}

summarise_dip_by_condition = function(dip_results, min_trials = 10) {
  dip_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_trials >= min_trials) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(study_label, condition) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_subj = n(), n_significant = sum(dip_p < .05), pct_significant = mean(dip_p < .05) * 100, .groups = "drop")
}

summarise_dip_overall = function(dip_results, min_trials = 10) {
  dip_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_trials >= min_trials) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(study_label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n_subj = n(),  n_significant = sum(dip_p < .05), pct_significant = mean(dip_p < .05) * 100, .groups = "drop")
}

dip_results = calc_dip_results(df_all_studies)

summarise_dip_by_condition(dip_results) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct_significant = round(pct_significant, 2))

summarise_dip_overall(dip_results) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct_significant = round(pct_significant, 2))
```

```{r heavy_contributors_dip}
fast_counts = df_all_studies %>%
  dplyr::left_join(empirical_thresholds, by = c("study_label", "condition")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study_label, condition, participant) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_trials = dplyr::n(),
    n_fast = sum(rt_ms < empirical_threshold_ms),
    median_rt_fast = median(rt_ms[rt_ms < empirical_threshold_ms]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct_fast = round(100 * n_fast / n_trials, 1))

heavy_ids = fast_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_fast >= 10) %>%
  dplyr::select(study_label, condition, participant, n_fast)

dip_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(dip_p < .05) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(fast_counts, by = c("study_label", "condition", "participant")) %>%
  dplyr::select(study_label, condition, participant, dip_p, n_fast, pct_fast, median_rt_fast) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_fast)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(median_rt_fast = sprintf("%.2f", median_rt_fast))
```

# Sensitivity check: 25-ms bins

```{r sensitivity_25ms}
caf_results_25 = calc_caf(df_all_studies, binwidth = my_caf_binwidth_sensitivity, min_n = 20)

calc_caf_threshold(caf_results_25) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_rt = round(mean_rt, 0),
    acc = round(acc, 2),
    ci_low  = round(ci_low, 2),
    ci_high = round(ci_high, 2)
  )

empirical_thresholds_25 = calc_caf_threshold(caf_results_25) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(study_label, condition, empirical_threshold_ms = mean_rt)

sensitivity_25ms = df_all_studies %>%
  dplyr::left_join(empirical_thresholds_25, by = c("study_label", "condition")) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(study_label, condition) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = dplyr::n(),
    n_below_empirical = sum(rt_ms < unique(empirical_threshold_ms)),
    pct_below_empirical = round(mean(rt_ms < unique(empirical_threshold_ms)) * 100, 2),
    n_correct_below = sum(correct[rt_ms < unique(empirical_threshold_ms)]),
    acc_below_empirical = round(mean(correct[rt_ms < unique(empirical_threshold_ms)], na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ci_low = round(binom.test(n_correct_below, n_below_empirical)$conf.int[1], 3),
    ci_high = round(binom.test(n_correct_below, n_below_empirical)$conf.int[2], 3)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

print(sensitivity_25ms, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```
